summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for Patient History/Revisit/Treatment tracking on preview URL. Backend scenarios 1-6 and role regression passed via reusable pytest (4/4): first/return/third-visit behavior, immutable earlier records, baseline derivation over >200 prior visits, timeline paging correctness, microsecond+timezone ordering, ambiguous current-visit timestamp safe 422, and clinical-history role guards. Frontend workflow checks passed for real reception→doctor flow: revisit history panel, retry-after-failed-history preserving typed notes, current visit fields independent/blank before edit, previous Rx read-only with current Rx not auto-prefilled, and responsive checks at 320/768/1024/1440 with no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout not enforced per playbook expectation: after 5 invalid attempts, valid login still succeeds immediately (200).

minor.issue: Auth testing playbook file is missing in workspace, so documented auth checklist could not be fully followed from local guide.

action_items: Implement and verify auth brute-force lockout policy (playbook target: lockout after 5 failed attempts).
Restore /app/auth_testing.md in repository if it is required operationally for future auth RCA/testing handoffs.
Optional hardening: add data-testid attributes to per-item prescription inputs/buttons in doctor CaseDetail for deeper automation granularity.
critical_code_review_comments: patients.py consultation history pipeline correctly keeps default legacy timeline behavior unchanged when for_case_id is omitted.
cases.py save_notes uses exclude_unset and nested field-set handling, which correctly supports dirty-only updates without auto-copying inherited baseline.
ClinicalNotesEditor and PatientHistoryPanel guard against cross-case stale state (for_case_id checks, retry behavior), reducing wrong-case data leakage risk.
Auth router currently has no failed-attempt counters/lockout state, creating brute-force exposure versus stated testing playbook expectation.

success_rate.backend: 95% (history/revisit scope 100%; auth playbook lockout check failed)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (targeted workflow checks passed; one intermediate selector assumption rerun corrected)

seed_data_creation: Created synthetic HISTORYREG/UIHIST patients and revisit cases through real APIs/UI; backend test fixture auto-cleaned synthetic patients using admin delete teardown. UI-created records were retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite added: test_iteration15_patient_history_tracking.py. It covers >200 history baseline derivation, pagination metadata/disjoint pages, microsecond+timezone ordering, ambiguous timestamp 422 safety, and role guards for for_case_id. Frontend retry-preserve test was validated by injecting one timeline request failure and using retry button without losing typed notes.
rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout gap RCA: /api/auth/login validates password and returns 401 on failures but does not persist attempt counters, lockout windows, or cooldown state. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password 5 times (all 401), then immediately POST valid credentials returns 200. Mitigation: add username/IP attempt tracking with threshold+TTL lockout and audit logging, and include lockout reset on successful authentication.
